resources.string: Switch profiles with a sequence on the side buttons.
Stopped, or phone asleep (last sign %1$d s ago)
Not installed. Install it to start the daemon without a computer.
Installed but not started. Start it in the Shizuku app; the daemon will follow on its own.
Version too old, please update it.
Permission denied. Grant it in the Shizuku app.
Runs the daemon. It will restart with Shizuku.
Shizuku starts the daemon without a computer. One-time setup, about 2 minutes.
All set. After a reboot, only step 5 needs doing again.
From the Play Store, or from GitHub (RikkaApps/Shizuku).
Settings › About phone: tap Build number 7 times.
Connect to Wi-Fi, then Settings › System › Developer options › Wireless debugging.
In Shizuku: Start via Wireless debugging › Pairing. Then in Wireless debugging: Pair device with pairing code, and type that code into Shizuku.
Fold open: put Settings and Shizuku side by side (split screen), read the code on one side and type it on the other.
Fold closed: type the code straight into Shizuku\'s notification (pull down the shade, Enter pairing code), or open the Fold to see both apps side by side.
Type the code straight into Shizuku\'s notification: pull down the shade, then Enter pairing code.
In Shizuku: Start. Again after every reboot: without root, Shizuku cannot start on its own.
Tap the button and accept: the daemon starts, and follows Shizuku from then on.
Do your sequence on the buttons now, then wait a second.\nAt least 3 points: 1 per press, +1 for a long press, +1 for several buttons together.
Record one, then pick the profile it opens.
This app already blocks overlays, ignores taps through other windows and asks for memory tagging. GrapheneOS can harden it further; in Settings › Apps › User Switch (names may vary by release):
Dynamic code loading, from memory and from storage: restricted. The app never loads code.
Sensors permission: denied. The app reads the buttons through the daemon, not through sensors.
The daemon runs with ADB shell rights, outside these settings: if you stop using the app, stop the daemon and Shizuku too.
Start the daemon with ADB, again after every reboot:
Start Shizuku: the daemon will follow on its own within 1 to 2 minutes (or tap here).
